title: Per-Call Telemetry Join Contract (phase 89-05)
description: Canonical field set and join rules for unifying whiteboard/trace/gad-log/worker-log streams into per-call records.

model.description: Concrete model id when known; today whiteboard usually contributes only model_profile as a weaker hint

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds; null if not reported

success.description: Did the call succeed? null if stream does not indicate success

tokens.description: Token counts; all null in phase 89 baseline — reserved for future runtime emissions

task_id.description: Task ID this call contributes to; null if no linkage

handoff_id.description: Handoff ID; null if no linkage

artifact_lineage.description: Artifact IDs produced by this call

join_keys.description: Keys used to correlate records across streams

handoff_id.method: Exact match: whiteboard session-start.claimed_handoff + attribution-link.artifact_id (handoff-complete) ↔ worker-log ref

ts_plus_runtime.method: Temporal window: events within ±5s with same runtime value

step_id.method: Internal: correlate tool-call.step_id / step-end.step_id to attribution-link.step_id

source_rules.description: How each field is populated from each stream

whiteboard.model: derived (session-start.model_profile today; reserved for concrete model ids when adapters expose them)
whiteboard.task_id: derived join (attribution-link.artifact_id where artifact_kind=task-stamp, correlated by step_id)

worker-log.task_id: derived join (ref handoff id -> whiteboard session/handoff join -> task-stamp attribution)

conflict_resolution.description: Which stream wins when the same field conflicts across streams
conflict_resolution.runtime: whiteboard session-start.runtime wins; trace/gad-log runtime.id is fallback
conflict_resolution.model: today whiteboard model_profile is the best available hint; if adapters later emit concrete model ids, the whiteboard concrete model wins
conflict_resolution.duration_ms: whiteboard tool-call.duration_ms > trace duration_ms > gad-log duration_ms > worker-log duration_ms (coarsest)
conflict_resolution.success: whiteboard tool-call.ok for tool calls; worker-log exit_code===0 for whole-work items
conflict_resolution.task_id: whiteboard attribution-link + session-start.claimed_handoff win; worker-log ref is fallback join key
conflict_resolution.handoff_id: whiteboard session-start.claimed_handoff wins; worker-log ref is fallback

missing_token_policy.description: How to handle missing token counts (phase 89 baseline: no stream reports tokens)
missing_token_policy.action: Output null for all tokens.* fields
missing_token_policy.note: Null means null. Future runtime emissions will populate these fields.

rate_limit_evidence.description: How rate-limit events in worker-log are recovered
rate_limit_evidence.token_availability: No token data for rate-limited calls (call was blocked before token consumption)
